## Decisions

- `kb:adr/actions-pane-snapshot-display-only` — The daemon captures each live pane on every liveness tick and serves the last capture for a dead session, dimmed under an ended cap; display only. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus) → `docs/adr/actions-pane-snapshot-display-only.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-remove-allowed-on-live-session` — Remove is allowed on a live session; it ends the session first and its dialog says so, then deletes the row and broadcasts sessionRemoved. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/actions-remove-allowed-on-live-session.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-drives-installed-claude-through-production-chain` — The canary launches the installed claude through the production settings, shell, wrapper and enveloped POST chain; previously skipped field tests are binding. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-drives-installed-claude-through-production-chain.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-exact-pin-bumped-after-green-runs` — Muster pins one exact Claude Code version, and the pin moves only after the canary has run green against the new version. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-exact-pin-bumped-after-green-runs.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-interactive-dialog-rows-accepted-residual` — Behaviours behind an interactive dialog (plan mode, PermissionRequest, Notification, SubagentStop) stay outside the canary and are verified by probe on demand. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: canary) → `docs/adr/canary-interactive-dialog-rows-accepted-residual.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-banner-only-after-first-hello` — The daemon-down banner appears only after a first successful hello; a fresh page load shows a connecting state instead. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-banner-only-after-first-hello.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-built-assets-ignored-with-gitkeep` — Built dashboard assets are gitignored; a committed placeholder keeps the embed directive compiling on a fresh clone, and the web build restores it. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-built-assets-ignored-with-gitkeep.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-commands-http-ws-push-only` — Commands go over HTTP; the state WebSocket is server-to-client only, and the only client-to-server socket traffic is terminal input and resize. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-commands-http-ws-push-only.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-dashboard-auto-opens-on-terminal` — musterd opens the dashboard in the browser at startup by default, only when stdin is a real terminal; that condition, not the flag, keeps tests browser-free. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-dashboard-auto-opens-on-terminal.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-dashboard-embedded-in-binary` — The built dashboard is embedded in musterd and served by default; the disk directory flag remains as a development override with unchanged behaviour. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-dashboard-embedded-in-binary.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-missing-web-build-fails-fast` — A musterd built with no dashboard and no disk override exits non-zero at startup naming both remedies, replacing the old silent-404 mode. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-missing-web-build-fails-fast.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-ui-token-reusable-not-one-time` — The UI token is reusable at the auth endpoint for the install's life; one-time described the launcher flow, not token burning. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-ui-token-reusable-not-one-time.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-whole-object-session-upserts` — The state stream sends whole session objects on every change; the client replaces by id and sorts for display itself. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: connection, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/connection-whole-object-session-upserts.md`
- `kb:adr/drop-daemon-locates-original-never-stages` — Dropping a file on a live pane types the original file's escaped path: the daemon locates it on disk by name, size and bytes, or types nothing; never a copy. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: drop, surfaces) → `docs/adr/drop-daemon-locates-original-never-stages.md`
- `kb:adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type` — Internal tile and rail reorder drags carry a Muster-specific MIME type instead of text/plain, so a dragover can tell a reorder from dragged text. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: drop, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal` — A pointer click on a rail card puts keyboard focus in that session's terminal; keyboard activation, number chords and the Tiles strip only select. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: focus, rail, surfaces) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane` — The Focus view is a rail of static cards beside exactly one live pane, with account usage in a persistent masthead. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: focus, rail, usage) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-all-hooks-command-wrappers` — Every hook and the status line is a command wrapper that exits silently when unmanaged or when the daemon is down; Muster writes no http hook entries. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-all-hooks-command-wrappers.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-envelope-authoritative-binding` — Every event is enveloped; a new session_id on an enveloped event is a clear-style rebind, a never-bound session binds on it, raw and status posts never bind. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-envelope-authoritative-binding.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-hook-entries-permanent` — Muster's hook entries in a directory are permanent by design; no reference counting, no strip on shutdown, no strip on remove. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-hook-entries-permanent.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-monotonic-rebind` — An enveloped event never rebinds a session backwards onto a Claude session_id it has already left; reordered stragglers apply without rebinding. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-monotonic-rebind.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-separate-token-in-url-path` — Two tokens: the UI token is exchanged for a strict same-site cookie, and a separate ingest token is embedded in the hook URL path. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: ingest, connection) → `docs/adr/ingest-separate-token-in-url-path.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest` — Events carry no timestamps or order, so the daemon assigns a monotonic seq at ingest, returns 200 at once, and processes asynchronously. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-shell-quote-at-write-boundary` — MergeSettings single-quotes both command-hook paths at the write boundary; the default data dir with a space stays and nothing else quotes. (accepted, 2026-08-25; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-shell-quote-at-write-boundary.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-wire-shaped-fixtures-via-claudecodetest` — Tests outside the Claude Code package get wire-shaped bodies from a claudecodetest helper package rather than narrowing the boundary check. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: ingest) → `docs/adr/ingest-wire-shaped-fixtures-via-claudecodetest.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-auth-gh-token-at-time-of-use` — Issue filing uses the GitHub CLI's token read at time of use; nothing is stored, there is no OAuth flow, and the GitHub host is a single flag default. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/issue-auth-gh-token-at-time-of-use.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-capture-then-file-server-held` — Filing is two steps: the daemon holds an immutable snapshot in a small expiring store, and the file request names the held capture, never a client payload. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/issue-capture-then-file-server-held.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-daemon-creates-issues-only` — The daemon's involvement ends at creating an issue: no reading, labels or status sync; a filed issue's fate is a developer-workflow concern outside musterd. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue, triage) → `docs/adr/issue-daemon-creates-issues-only.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-disabled-button-affordance-deferred` — The issue dialog ships its disabled primary button with no distinct visual state, like every other button; an app-wide disabled sweep is a backlog item. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue, theme) → `docs/adr/issue-disabled-button-affordance-deferred.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-payload-allowlist-never-dump` — The issue snapshot is assembled by explicit field copy from a pinned allowlist; prompt-derived, identifying and account-usage data are excluded forever. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/issue-payload-allowlist-never-dump.md`
- `kb:adr/issue-preview-is-the-leak-check` — The issue dialog renders the daemon's snapshot markdown verbatim before posting, and E2E asserts the preview is byte-identical to the body GitHub receives. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/issue-preview-is-the-leak-check.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-browse-via-daemon-not-native-chooser` — Directory choice browses through a daemon listing endpoint rooted at a configurable home, because browsers never reveal a picked folder's absolute path. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-browse-via-daemon-not-native-chooser.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-form-seeds-model-and-permission-mode` — The launch form asks for model and starting permission mode; the mode seeds a last-known latch that the first hook corrects. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-form-seeds-model-and-permission-mode.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-hybrid-mru-directory-memory` — Directory memory is hybrid MRU plus promotion; v1 recognises a worktree it is pointed at but never creates one. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-hybrid-mru-directory-memory.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-model-presets-passed-verbatim` — The Model control offers named presets, including fable, that are passed to --model verbatim; the daemon accepts any non-empty model string. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-model-presets-passed-verbatim.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-permission-modes-offered-four-tabbed` — The Start-in control offers Claude Code's four tabbed modes under its own labels; default stays the wire value behind manual and auto is new end to end. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-permission-modes-offered-four-tabbed.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-picker-recent-sidebar-plus-browse-list` — The launch dialog is a Finder-style picker: a Recent sidebar beside a breadcrumb over one child listing, where the listed directory is the selection. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-picker-recent-sidebar-plus-browse-list.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-project-scoped-settings-not-config-dir` — Muster instruments a directory through project-scoped .claude settings, never through CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, which breaks subscription OAuth. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/launch-project-scoped-settings-not-config-dir.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-settings-local-json-not-settings-json` — Muster writes the gitignored project settings.local.json, which alone honours hooks and status line, so the ingest token never lands in a committable file. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/launch-settings-local-json-not-settings-json.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-trust-prompt-never-auto-answered` — The workspace-trust prompt is surfaced to the user and never auto-answered; it is detected by absence of signal plus Muster's records. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-trust-prompt-never-auto-answered.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-alive-flag-not-a-state` — Liveness is an orthogonal alive flag, not a seventh state; a resumed session re-enters idle and a clear resets gauges but not identity. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-alive-flag-not-a-state.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-ended-rows-swept-next-start` — On start, rows already ended are deleted and live rows whose pane is gone are marked ended and kept, so every death gets one resume chance. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-ended-rows-swept-next-start.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-liveness-from-pane-existence` — Whether a session is alive is decided by tmux pane existence alone; SessionEnd is a hint and never sets or clears alive. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-liveness-from-pane-existence.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-migrations-add-tables-when-written` — A migration ships only the tables its milestone writes; the spec's schema sketch is not frozen into the first migration. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-migrations-add-tables-when-written.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-prompt-ordering-guards` — Events apply in seq order; Stop-family events close their prompt_id, a closed prompt never reopens, and an unseen prompt_id starts a turn. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-prompt-ordering-guards.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-reconcile-before-first-snapshot` — Reconcile on start runs synchronously before the first snapshot is served; unknown Muster-shaped tmux sessions are logged and never adopted. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-reconcile-before-first-snapshot.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-resume-rebinds-existing-session` — Resuming a dead session keeps the Muster row and its title and rebinds it to the new pane, matched on the unchanged Claude session_id. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-resume-rebinds-existing-session.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-session-identity-is-tmux-target` — A Muster session is identified by its tmux target; the Claude session_id is a mutable attribute that /clear replaces in the same pane. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-session-identity-is-tmux-target.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-shutdown-leaves-sessions-running` — Sessions survive daemon shutdown by policy; the on-exit flag offers ask, leave and kill, with ask defaulting to leave without a terminal. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-shutdown-leaves-sessions-running.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-subagent-marked-events-not-stragglers` — A subagent-marked hook for a closed prompt moves the session to working or needs-input without reopening it; unmarked stragglers stay inert. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-subagent-marked-events-not-stragglers.md`
- `kb:adr/process-contributions-deferred-to-first-pr` — No CLA or DCO pre-emptively; inbound contributions are decided at the first real pull request, and the README says issues yes, pull requests not yet. (accepted, 2026-09-04) → `docs/adr/process-contributions-deferred-to-first-pr.md`
- `kb:adr/process-e2e-explicit-fixtures` — Every E2E spec declares its daemon fixture from one helpers module: fresh per test by default, per-file only when title-scoped; plans record the choice. (accepted, 2026-09-06) → `docs/adr/process-e2e-explicit-fixtures.md`
- `kb:adr/process-e2e-lint-mechanises-fixture-rules` — A lint before every E2E run and in the gates fails a spec that spawns its own daemon, imports Playwright directly or sleeps; the web implementer owns it. (accepted, 2026-09-06) → `docs/adr/process-e2e-lint-mechanises-fixture-rules.md`
- `kb:adr/process-e2e-one-load-policy` — One load policy in the Playwright config: four workers, 15 s expect and 60 s test timeouts; specs may shorten a timeout, never lengthen one. (accepted, 2026-09-06) → `docs/adr/process-e2e-one-load-policy.md`
- `kb:adr/process-faked-subprocess-boundary` — Go tests cross a process boundary through an injectable run function, never a PATH shim; real tmux appears only for tmux-observable assertions. (accepted, 2026-09-06) → `docs/adr/process-faked-subprocess-boundary.md`
- `kb:adr/process-interface-probe-rig-in-repo` — Wire-format questions are answered by the in-repo probe rig through the interface-probe skill, against the real pinned binary, with findings in spikes/. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: canary) → `docs/adr/process-interface-probe-rig-in-repo.md`
- `kb:adr/process-land-skill-is-the-landing-ritual` — Landing is its own step: it gates on an approved review, composes the closing subject, shows the predicted bump, pushes, and deletes the branch by content diff. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: release, triage) → `docs/adr/process-land-skill-is-the-landing-ritual.md`
- `kb:adr/process-licence-mit` — The licence is MIT, over Apache-2.0 and AGPL-3.0; copyright is retained, so relicensing or sale stays open. (accepted, 2026-09-04) → `docs/adr/process-licence-mit.md`
- `kb:adr/process-real-verification-post-run-by-pipeline` — A plan's single real external call is run by the orchestrator from the main session under live permission approval, not by a subagent and not by hand. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue) → `docs/adr/process-real-verification-post-run-by-pipeline.md`
- `kb:adr/process-release-breaking-marker-bang-gated` — The exclamation mark is the only breaking marker, legal only when a human sets MUSTER_BREAKING=1; the footer phrase is banned outright by the hook. (accepted, 2026-09-01; features: release) → `docs/adr/process-release-breaking-marker-bang-gated.md`
- `kb:adr/process-release-bump-map-widened-perf-refactor` — A feat bumps minor; fix, perf and refactor bump patch; every other type releases nothing. svu hardwires only feat and fix, so the workflow shims the other two. (accepted, 2026-09-01; features: release) → `docs/adr/process-release-bump-map-widened-perf-refactor.md`
- `kb:adr/process-release-commitlint-eleven-types` — Commit types are the eleven-strong commitlint conventional list, plus review(<plan>) on plan branches only; the list is enforced by a commit-msg hook. - `kb:adr/release-two-arch-archives-not-universal` — The release ships separate amd64 and arm64 darwin archives rather than a universal binary; the installer picks by machine architecture. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: release) → `docs/adr/release-two-arch-archives-not-universal.md`
- `kb:adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins` — A post-launch rename is a Muster-owned nullable title override that wins over the status-line name; the wire title is the display title. - `kb:adr/stack-websocket-coder` — WebSockets use coder/websocket; the stdlib has none, x/net/websocket is deprecated, and Echo would wrap a third-party library anyway. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: connection, surfaces) → `docs/adr/stack-websocket-coder.md`

- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-tmux-session-per-session` — Each Muster session is its own tmux session, named muster-<id>, because a tmux client attaches to a session and Tiles needs several live at once. - `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-control-in-tile-footer` — The tile's surface control lives in the footer action row, not the specced header, because a header control truncated every title at the dense grid. - `kb:adr/theme-aa-contrast-gated-in-check` — Every theme meets WCAG AA for text and non-text UI, hairlines exempt, gated by a contrast script under make check; the one bounded accessibility exception. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-aa-contrast-gated-in-check.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-banner-tokens-not-rose` — The daemon-down banner uses dedicated banner tokens; the rose token stays reserved for the Failed state. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: theme, connection) → `docs/adr/theme-banner-tokens-not-rose.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-claude-theme-read-only-poll` — Claude Code's theme is read, never set: musterd polls one key of Claude's config file read-only and broadcasts a light, dark or unknown family. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, connection) → `docs/adr/theme-claude-theme-read-only-poll.md`

- `kb:adr/theme-danger-tokens-not-rose` — Destructive actions use a danger token family; rose stays reserved for the Failed state rather than the rule being amended. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: theme, actions) → `docs/adr/theme-danger-tokens-not-rose.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-instrument-visual-direction` — Visual direction A, instrument: dark, dense, mono metadata, session state as a coloured rail stripe; the design system is the review checklist. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-instrument-visual-direction.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-pref-enum-follow-not-nullable` — The theme pref is an enum with a follow default, not a nullable; the daemon validates a pattern and treats the value as opaque, the client owns the registry. - `kb:adr/theme-term-split-from-well` — The pane ground token splits from a new well token: the pane follows Claude Code's family, chrome recesses ground on the well, which follows the Muster theme. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-term-split-from-well.md`

- `kb:adr/tiles-order-ephemeral-per-window` — Tile order is per-window and ephemeral, held with grid membership in client state; nothing is persisted and the protocol is untouched. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-order-ephemeral-per-window.md`

- `kb:adr/usage-keychain-token-read-only` — The daemon reads Claude Code's OAuth token from the macOS Keychain read-only for usage polling; never logged, stored or sent on the wire; tests use file seams. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-keychain-token-read-only.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-model-from-freshest-sample` — The masthead shows the model from the freshest usage sample; flicker under mixed-model sessions is accepted. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-model-from-freshest-sample.md`

- `kb:adr/usage-model-window-polled-from-oauth-api` — The per-model weekly window comes from the daemon polling Claude Code's OAuth usage endpoint on a timer plus a coalesced manual refresh, not the status line. - `kb:adr/usage-no-hydration-across-restart` — Account usage reads unknown after a daemon restart until the next status post; per-session context persists on the session row. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-no-hydration-across-restart.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-no-source-interface` — Usage sources share a neutral Sample type and one aggregator, with no Go interface type until a second source forces one. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-no-source-interface.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-sample-dedup-by-value` — A usage sample is recorded and broadcast only when its bucket values or model changed; duplicates are dropped by value, not by timestamp. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-sample-dedup-by-value.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-unknown-renders-word-not-track` — An unknown gauge renders the word unknown with no track drawn; a zero-filled track is forbidden because it reads as zero percent used. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-unknown-renders-word-not-track.md`
- `kb:adr/views-active-segment-click-commits-rename` — Clicking the already-pressed view segment commits an open rename instead of cancelling it and sends no prefs request; switching views still cancels. - `kb:adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers` — The dashboard has two peer views, Focus and Tiles, switched from the masthead or a chord, with the choice persisted daemon-side. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: views, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers.md`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/background-completion-new-prompt-id` — A finished background task re-invokes the main agent as a UserPromptSubmit with a new prompt_id whose prompt begins <task-notification>. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-completion-new-prompt-id.md`
- `kb:fact/background-tasks-field` — Stop.background_tasks lists running subagents and backgrounded shells with status "running", [] when nothing is outstanding. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-tasks-field.md`
- `kb:fact/clear-mints-new-session-id` — /clear emits SessionEnd{reason:"clear"} for the old session_id, then SessionStart{source:"clear"} with a new id in the same pane. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/clear-mints-new-session-id.md`
- `kb:fact/command-hooks-inherit-pane-env` — Command hooks and the status-line script inherit the pane environment on every event, ~50 ms per event; an unmanaged session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/command-hooks-inherit-pane-env.md`
- `kb:fact/config-dir-breaks-oauth` — CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolates settings, hooks and transcripts but breaks subscription OAuth ("Not logged in · Please run /login"). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, launch) → `docs/facts/config-dir-breaks-oauth.md`
- `kb:fact/context-window-shape` — context_window carries context_window_size, used/remaining_percentage on a 0-100 scale, token totals and a current_usage object. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/context-window-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/fable-model-alias` — fable is a valid --model alias: the bundle's alias switch has case"fable":case"mythos" beside haiku/sonnet/opus. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: launch) → `docs/facts/fable-model-alias.md`
- `kb:fact/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence` — Headless claude -p fires the full hook sequence, including the command-wrapped SessionStart, so hook probes need no tmux. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, ingest) → `docs/facts/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-commands-are-shell-lines` — Command-hook command and statusLine.command are /bin/sh -c command lines, not argv paths; an unquoted space-bearing path breaks both. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.245..2.1.267; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/facts/hook-commands-are-shell-lines.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-delivery-best-effort` — Hooks are at-most-once with no timestamps or sequence numbers; kill -9 emits nothing and a SIGTERM emits SessionEnd but no Stop-family event. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/hook-delivery-best-effort.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-payload-fields` — Per-event hook field inventory: the common set on every hook, prompt_id on all but SessionStart, and each event's own fields. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/hook-payload-fields.md`
- `kb:fact/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit` — On the authentication-failure exit Claude Code does not wait for hook children: StopFailure is at risk and SessionEnd is usually lost. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.246..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, canary) → `docs/facts/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/local-settings-honoured` — Project-scoped .claude/settings.json and settings.local.json alone each honour hooks, statusLine and allowedHttpHookUrls. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/facts/local-settings-honoured.md`
- `kb:fact/name-flag-reaches-title` — claude --name X yields SessionStart.session_title == X and status-line session_name == X; the title survives --resume. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.267; features: launch, rename) → `docs/facts/name-flag-reaches-title.md`
- `kb:fact/notification-types-observed` — Notification.notification_type: idle_prompt ~60 s after Stop, and permission_prompt sharing PermissionRequest's prompt_id. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/notification-types-observed.md`
- `kb:fact/oauth-token-in-keychain` — The subscription OAuth token lives in the macOS Keychain item "Claude Code-credentials" as claudeAiOauth.accessToken. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/oauth-token-in-keychain.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-auto-model-gated` — --permission-mode auto is model-gated: on haiku the TUI prints "auto mode unavailable for this model" and every hook reports default. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-auto-model-gated.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-flag-on-wire` — --permission-mode is reflected verbatim on UserPromptSubmit.permission_mode; the CLI's manual choice is spelled default on the wire. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-flag-on-wire.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-presence-split` — permission_mode is not universal: six hook events always carry it, five never do; values seen are default, plan, acceptEdits, auto. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-presence-split.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-suggestions-optional` — PermissionRequest.permission_suggestions is optional: present on a Write request in default mode, absent on ExitPlanMode in plan mode. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/permission-suggestions-optional.md`
- `kb:fact/plan-mode-hook-sequence` — Leaving plan mode fires PreToolUse{ExitPlanMode, plan}, then PermissionRequest{ExitPlanMode}, then PostToolUse{ExitPlanMode, acceptEdits}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/plan-mode-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/rate-limits-wire-shape` — rate_limits has five_hour and seven_day buckets (not weekly), each {used_percentage: float, resets_at: Unix epoch integer}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/rate-limits-wire-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/refresh-interval-seconds` — statusLine.refreshInterval is in seconds, not milliseconds, and ticks while idle; without it an idle session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/refresh-interval-seconds.md`
- `kb:fact/resume-keeps-session-identity` — claude --resume <id> emits SessionStart{source:"resume"} with the original session_id and transcript_path. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/facts/resume-keeps-session-identity.md`
- `kb:fact/scroll-speed-env-present` — CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED is present in the installed bundle; the static canary tier asserts every LaunchEnv key by byte string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.267; features: launch, surfaces) → `docs/facts/scroll-speed-env-present.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionend-reason-ambiguous` — SessionEnd.reason is "other" for both a killed pane and a normal exit; only "clear" is distinguishable, and kill -9 emits nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/sessionend-reason-ambiguous.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionstart-model-optional-string` — SessionStart.model, when present, is a plain model-ID string, never an object; it is absent on headless startups and on /clear. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/sessionstart-model-optional-string.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionstart-not-over-http` — SessionStart is silently never delivered over a type:"http" hook; the other nine events are. A type:"command" hook delivers it. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/sessionstart-not-over-http.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-has-no-model-bucket` — The status line carries only five_hour and seven_day (plus spend_limit on gateway accounts); the per-model weekly window is never copied in. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-line-has-no-model-bucket.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-keys` — Status-line top-level keys; permission_mode is never among them. Newer versions add scratchpad_dir and prompt_cache (superset). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/status-line-keys.md`
- `kb:fact/status-model-is-object` — The status line's model is an {id, display_name} object; only SessionStart.model is a bare string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/status-model-is-object.md`
- `kb:fact/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs` — Status-line posts are event-driven, ~50 ms after tool activity, and arrive in close pairs a median 435 ms apart. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs.md`
- `kb:fact/status-session-name-source` — Status-line session_name carries --name when given, otherwise a title Claude Code auto-generates; it is absent until one exists. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: rename, usage) → `docs/facts/status-session-name-source.md`
- `kb:fact/status-version-matches-installed` — The status-line version field equals the installed claude --version. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, connection) → `docs/facts/status-version-matches-installed.md`
- `kb:fact/stopfailure-error-taxonomy` — StopFailure.error observed: authentication_failed, server_error, unknown; ten values exist in the binary, and the mapping is not pass-through. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/stopfailure-error-taxonomy.md`
- `kb:fact/stopfailure-replaces-stop` — A failed turn emits StopFailure instead of Stop, never both; a successful turn emits Stop only. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/stopfailure-replaces-stop.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-hooks-carry-agent-id` — Tool hooks fired by a subagent carry the parent prompt_id plus agent_id and agent_type, and arrive after the parent's Stop when backgrounded. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/subagent-hooks-carry-agent-id.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-permission-request-marked` — A subagent's PermissionRequest carries agent_id and agent_type; the permission_prompt Notification that follows carries no agent marker. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/subagent-permission-request-marked.md`
- `kb:fact/theme-config-key-and-enum` — Claude Code's theme is the global-config key theme with a six-value enum; family is startsWith("light"); default dark. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.258..2.1.267; features: theme) → `docs/facts/theme-config-key-and-enum.md`
- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-exit` — The workspace-trust prompt preselects "No, exit" (2.1.259+): a bare Enter exits the session; the harness moves the marker first. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/unknown-before-first-response` — Before a session's first API response rate_limits is absent and the context percentages are null: unknown, not 0%. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/unknown-before-first-response.md`
- `kb:fact/usage-api-oauth-shape` — GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the OAuth bearer and anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20 returns five_hour, seven_day and limits[]. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/usage-api-oauth-shape.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/connection-static-assets-from-disk` — The dashboard's static assets are served from a directory given by a flag, not embedded, so the Go build never depends on the web build. (superseded, 2026-08-22; features: connection) → `docs/adr/connection-static-assets-from-disk.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-envelope-binds-never-cwd` — SessionStart and status posts wrap their payload in an envelope naming the Muster session and pane; raw hooks route by session_id and never by cwd. (superseded, 2026-08-20; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-envelope-binds-never-cwd.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-sessionstart-command-wrapper` — SessionStart is delivered through a command-wrapper hook because it is never delivered over an http hook; the other events stay http. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: ingest) → `docs/adr/ingest-sessionstart-command-wrapper.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-bypass-and-dontask-unoffered` — The bypass-permissions and dont-ask modes stay unoffered until a permissions UI with guardrails exists; auto's guardrail is Claude Code's classifier. (rejected, 2026-09-03; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-bypass-and-dontask-unoffered.md`
- `kb:adr/nongoal-attention-ribbon-post-v1` — The attention ribbon, a timeline of session events, is not built in v1; the event table already carries what it would need. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: rail) → `docs/adr/nongoal-attention-ribbon-post-v1.md`
- `kb:adr/process-e2e-no-playwright-retries` — Playwright retries are not enabled, on CI or locally; a retry hides exactly the load sensitivity the gates exist to see, and there is no CI to scope one to. (rejected, 2026-09-06) → `docs/adr/process-e2e-no-playwright-retries.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-attention-sort-order` — The rail sorts by attention: Needs-Input longest-blocked first, then Failed, Planning, Working, Started, Idle longest-idle first. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: rail) → `docs/adr/rail-attention-sort-order.md`
- `kb:adr/release-no-ci-test-job-yet` — No test or lint job runs in CI for now; the release build is the compile gate, and adding the check target is one step when open-sourcing makes it worth having. (rejected, 2026-08-31; features: release) → `docs/adr/release-no-ci-test-job-yet.md`
- `kb:adr/release-versioning-automatic-from-conventional-commits` — Versions are computed from conventional commits since the last tag on every push to main; Muster stays on 0.x, so the breaking marker is not used. (superseded, 2026-08-31; features: release) → `docs/adr/release-versioning-automatic-from-conventional-commits.md`
- `kb:adr/rename-title-from-status-line-session-name` — A session's displayed title is read from the status line's session_name, which reflects --name, /rename and the auto-generated title alike. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: rename, usage) → `docs/adr/rename-title-from-status-line-session-name.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session` — A session is live on exactly one surface at one geometry at a time; every other rendering of it is a static snapshot. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-window-per-session` — Each session runs in its own tmux window inside one shared tmux session; sizing is a window-level operation. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-window-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-no-traffic-light-state-palette` — A green, orange and red traffic-light palette for the tile state dot was not adopted; state colours come only from the design system's state tokens. (rejected, 2026-08-29; features: tiles, theme) → `docs/adr/theme-no-traffic-light-state-palette.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-live-top-n-snapshot-rest` — In Tiles the live grid holds the top N sessions by attention and every other session is a snapshot card; density sets N and every tile's geometry. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-live-top-n-snapshot-rest.md`
- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-yes` — Retired: through 2.1.246 the workspace-trust prompt preselected "Yes", so a bare Enter accepted it. (retired, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.246; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-yes.md`
